ios.desc:
Zettel - Quick Notes for iOS.

Write. Swipe to tear. Done. Zettel brings the satisfying feeling of ripping paper to your iPhone.

What makes it different:
- One note at a time: Full screen. No tabs, no folders, no mess. Just you and your thoughts.
- Tear to clear: Swipe from the edge and drag across the screen. Your note tears away with haptic feedback that actually feels real.
- Tags that work: Type #anything and it becomes a tag. Find notes instantly without setting up complicated systems.
- Your files, anywhere: Notes are plain Markdown files. Edit them in other apps, sync however you want, or just keep them local.

Perfect for:
- Quick thoughts
- Meeting notes
- Daily journaling
- Project ideas

Simple by design:
- iPhone only (as it should be)
- Works with Files app
- Dark mode included
- No account required
- Zero tracking

Built by someone who got tired of overcomplicated note apps. Sometimes the best tools are the simplest ones.

quotes.text:
Hi HN!
A month ago, I wanted an app that opens instantly, stays out of the way, and stores every note as plain text. Nothing fit, so I built 'Zettel'.

Zettel is nothing crazy; it's a digital piece of paper on your phone: type, swipe, done. Each note lands as a .md file in the iOS Files app, which you can use to sync to any of your other devices or applications.

I use Zettel daily to quickly get thoughts out of my head, into my favourite App Obsidian.

Zettel is free & open source, and 1MB in size - feel free to try it out if you like!

https://apps.apple.com/de/app/zettel-quick-notes/id6748525244
